intro: Convert centimeters (cm) to feet (ft) accurately for human height, room layouts, doorway clearances, and furniture dimensions. Because 1 international foot equals exactly 30.48 centimeters (12 in × 2.54 cm), dividing your measurement in centimeters (or centimetres) by 30.48 gives exact decimal feet. Enter any height above or look up pre-computed lengths from 1 cm to 300 cm in the reference table below.
alsoWrittenAs: cm to ft, centimetres to feet, centimeter to foot, cm into feet
tableTitle: Centimeters to Feet Height & Length Chart (1 cm to 300 cm)
tableSubtitle: Exact decimal feet and tape-measure equivalents computed using ft = cm ÷ 30.48.
tableRoundingNote: Computed from the exact International Yard and Pound definition (1 ft = 30.48 cm; 1 cm = 1/30.48 ft ≈ 0.0328084 ft). Decimal feet in the table are rounded to 5 significant digits; use the calculator above for full floating-point output.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Decimal Feet vs. Feet and Inches (ft & in)
items: Do not read decimal feet directly as feet and inches: 5.71 ft equals 5 ft 8.5 in (0.71 × 12 = 8.5 in), not 5 ft 7 in.
To convert centimeters directly to feet and inches by hand, divide cm by 2.54 to get total inches, then divide by 12 to find whole feet and remaining inches.

faqs.question: How tall is 174 cm in feet and inches?
faqs.answer: 174 cm equals 5.70866 feet, which is 5 feet 8.5 inches (174 ÷ 30.48 = 5.70866 ft).

faqs.question: How do I convert centimeters to feet?
faqs.answer: Divide the length in centimeters by 30.48 (ft = cm ÷ 30.48), or multiply by 0.0328084. For example, 168 cm ÷ 30.48 = 5.51181 ft (5 ft 6.1 in).

faqs.question: How many feet are in 1 centimeter?
faqs.answer: 1 centimeter equals 0.0328084 feet (1 ÷ 30.48). Conversely, 1 foot equals exactly 30.48 centimeters.

faqs.question: What is 170.18 cm in feet?
faqs.answer: 170.18 cm equals 5.58333 feet, which is exactly 5 feet 7 inches (67 inches).
